description: Dynamic latched comparator (static differential preamplifier into a StrongARM latch with isolation inverters and a NOR SR output latch) for the GF180MCU open PDK. This is the integrator view: what a full-chip integrator takes, as structured data. Prose lives in README.md; consumer requirement rows live in spec/consumers.md.

layout.notes: One flat COMPARATOR top cell (29 devices: 27 transistors + 2 ppolyf_u_1k load resistors), generator source layout/gen_comparator.py.

ports.name: vinp
ports.meaning: differential input; v(vinp) > v(vinn) => dout HIGH

ports.name: clk
ports.meaning: decision strobe; LOW = reset, HIGH = evaluate

ports.name: ibias
ports.meaning: bias-current input pin; the testbench forces dut_ib into it

ports.name: dout
ports.meaning: complementary decision outputs, held between strobes

ports.name: doutb
ports.meaning: complementary decision outputs, held between strobes

port_list_source: sim/dut/README.md (Interface contract; checked textually at load time by sim/harness/dut.py)

area.derivation: placed bbox from layout/comparator.gen-compose.json bbox_um: x0=-0.25, y0=-0.25, x1=325.43, y1=62.99 -> 325.68 um x 63.24 um = 20596.0 um2
